en.headline: Taxi hits parked tour bus in Sau Mau Ping, two injured
en.dek: A 64-year-old taxi driver and a 35-year-old passenger suffered injuries after their vehicle collided with a stationary coach on a wet Shun Lee Tsuen Road early Saturday.
body: Police and firefighters responded to a collision shortly after midnight on Saturday in which a taxi struck a parked tour bus on Shun Lee Tsuen Road in Sau Mau Ping.

The taxi was travelling downhill towards Shun Tin Estate when it is believed to have skidded on the rain-slicked surface near On Kwan House of Shun On Estate and embedded its front into the rear of the coach.

The 64-year-old male driver, surnamed Chan, sustained chest and leg injuries while the 35-year-old male passenger, surnamed Mak, was hurt in the head and legs. Both remained conscious and were taken by ambulance to United Christian Hospital for treatment. No one was trapped inside the vehicles.

The front of the taxi was extensively crumpled with parts of the engine bay exposed, and debris littered the road. The lower left rear of the tour bus was also damaged. Officers continued to investigate the cause.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪的士撞停泊旅遊巴 兩人受傷
zh.dek: 周六凌晨一輛的士在雨濕的順利邨道撞向停泊旅遊巴，64歲司機及35歲乘客受傷送聯合醫院。
body: 警方及消防周六凌晨接報，秀茂坪順利邨道發生交通意外，一輛的士撞向一輛停泊在路邊的旅遊巴。
當時的士沿路下斜往順天邨方向行駛，途經順安邨安群樓對開時，懷疑因天雨路滑失控，車頭嵌入旅遊巴車尾。
64歲姓陳的士司機胸及腳受傷，35歲姓麥男乘客頭及腳受傷，兩人均清醒，由救護車送往基督教聯合醫院治理。車內無人被困。
的士車頭嚴重損毀變形，引擎艙外露，碎片散落；旅遊巴車尾左下方亦受損。警方正調查意外原因。
